assets.label: 近代炮兵工坊
assets.assetType: compact industrial-era artillery assembly workshop without any baked-in artillery unit
assets.primaryRequest: Preserve the exact supplied compact assembly workshop. One warm-gray brick hall has one continuous gray-blue metal gable roof, exactly two low flush skylight panels on the visible roof slope, one short brick chimney, the original side window and one small gear emblem on the visible side wall. Keep the original front assembly entrance visibly open behind the single left-side steel hoist. Preserve its flanged beam, suspended hook, wheel-and-axle stock at the foot, the two short floor assembly rails and the single right-side wooden tool table with vise and the authored hanging hand tools. Use matte charcoal steel, subdued aged brass, quiet brick, restrained roof seams and worn timber. Keep every component in its modeled position on the complete shallow fieldstone footing. Gentle diffuse fill keeps the open entrance and spaces between hoist posts readable.
assets.negativeRequest: No artillery piece, complete gun, vehicle, engineer, person, animal, extra hoist, extra worktable, extra wheel group, third skylight, roof monitor, second roof, second hall, additional chimney, tower, new machinery, glowing blueprint or readable text. Absolutely no cast shadow of any kind, ground shadow, backdrop shadow, green-screen shadow gradient or detached ambient shadow.
assets.detailRequest: Refine only material surfaces and fine finish. Keep the selected composition, all modeled openings and component layout unchanged.
